prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a turquoise-toned cinematic close-up of an adult man looking out a rain-streaked window in a dark dimly lit room. He has dark wavy hair and wears a white shirt with the top buttons open. His head is tilted back slightly and his expression is quiet and contemplative. Use cool turquoise window light from the right, deep low-key interior shadows, rain texture on glass, a 35mm film-still aesthetic, 50mm f/1.8 shallow depth, visible grain, and natural skin and fabric texture. Preserve a melancholic cinematic mood without cigarette, smoke, or flame.
